description: Caption card text (doc/design.md section 5.4.2) for a project, a scope (null for the full take, else a clip id), a caption style and the Settings switch. Layout words are timed [0.4 i, 0.4 i + 0.35] with only the key word emphasised, and drawn at time: 0.35 x 0.98 into the key word (captions spec 15.3), or for a reveal style at its last word, at that word's end when holdGapSec > 0. Drops are the fit's successive shorter cards (section 5.4.3). standIns are the section 5.4.1 precedence over the 5.4.4 states: frame, card (a card without words draws only the style's backdrop) or black.
